name: Coal
bestY: 45 (real-world sampling); two generation batches peak around Y=95 and Y=136
notes: Needs no special pickaxe (wood). More common in exposed cliff faces since it ignores air exposure.

name: Copper
notes: Stone pickaxe or better. Blobs are much bigger in dripstone caves biomes.

name: Iron
notes: Stone pickaxe or better. Two main batches: deep iron around Y=14 and a huge mountain batch peaking at Y=232.

name: Gold
notes: Iron pickaxe or better. Badlands bonus: extra gold generates between Y=32 and Y=256 - the best Overworld gold.

name: Lapis Lazuli
notes: Stone pickaxe or better. Never generates exposed to air - you must dig for it.

name: Redstone
notes: Iron pickaxe or better. Shares the deep triangle with diamonds - mine both on the same trip.

name: Diamond
notes: Iron pickaxe or better. Reduced air exposure since 1.18: branch mining beats cave exploring. Deepslate variants below Y=8.

name: Emerald
notes: Mountain biomes only, single scattered blocks (no blobs). Iron pickaxe or better. Usually easier to get via trading.

name: Nether Quartz
bestY: around 114, but common everywhere up to 120
notes: Wood pickaxe or better. Great early XP source in the Nether.

name: Nether Gold
notes: Any pickaxe. Drops nuggets - use Fortune or Silk Touch (smelt for a full ingot's worth).

name: Ancient Debris
notes: Diamond pickaxe or better, never exposed to air. Bed or TNT mining at Y=15-16 is the standard method.
